text.summary: The microblog application is a web-based platform for users to create and share posts, interact with other users, and manage their profiles. It provides features such as user authentication, post creation, following and unfollowing, and searching for posts. The application also includes a translation feature and allows users to export their posts.
text.how_it_works: When a user requests a page, the application starts at the entry point app/__init__.py::create_app, which creates and returns a Flask application. The application then routes the request to the appropriate endpoint, such as app/main/routes.py::index for the main page or app/api/users.py::get_users for listing users. The application uses a SQL database through Flask-SQLAlchemy to store and retrieve data, and Redis as a cache and message queue. Elasticsearch is used for search functionality. The application also sends emails through Flask-Mail and writes files to disk. Background tasks are handled through RQ task queue on Redis.
